name: Vendor/Supplier Agreement Template

sections.title: Parties
sections.content:
This Vendor Agreement ("Agreement") is entered into on [DATE] between:

[BUYER NAME], having its office at [ADDRESS] (hereinafter referred to as the "Buyer")

AND

[VENDOR NAME], having its office at [ADDRESS], GSTIN: [GSTIN] (hereinafter referred to as the "Vendor")

sections.title: Scope of Supply
sections.content:
1. The Vendor agrees to supply the following goods/materials:
   [Item 1] - Quantity: [X] - Unit Price: Rs. [AMOUNT]
   [Item 2] - Quantity: [X] - Unit Price: Rs. [AMOUNT]
2. Detailed specifications are attached as Schedule A.
3. Any variation must be approved in writing.

sections.title: Orders and Delivery
sections.content:
1. Orders shall be placed via purchase order (PO).
2. Delivery shall be made within [X] days of PO receipt.
3. Delivery location: [ADDRESS]
4. Delivery shall be accompanied by:
   a) Delivery challan
   b) Quality certificate
   c) GST invoice

sections.title: Pricing and Payment
sections.content:
1. Prices are as per Schedule B and include all applicable taxes.
2. Payment terms: [30/45/60] days from invoice date.
3. Payment shall be made via [NEFT/RTGS/Cheque].
4. The Buyer may withhold payment for disputed items.
5. GST shall be charged as applicable and shown separately.

sections.title: Quality Standards
sections.content:
1. All goods shall conform to specifications in Schedule A.
2. The Vendor warrants that goods shall be:
   a) Free from defects in material and workmanship
   b) Fit for intended purpose
   c) Compliant with applicable standards
3. Non-conforming goods may be rejected.

sections.title: Inspection and Acceptance
sections.content:
1. The Buyer shall inspect goods within [7] days of delivery.
2. Non-conforming goods shall be rejected with written notice.
3. Rejected goods shall be replaced at Vendor's cost within [15] days.
4. Acceptance shall not waive latent defect claims.

sections.title: Warranty
sections.content:
1. The Vendor warrants goods for [12/24] months from delivery.
2. Warranty covers defects in material and workmanship.
3. Warranty excludes damage from misuse or unauthorized modification.
4. Defective goods under warranty shall be repaired/replaced at no cost.

sections.title: Indemnity
sections.content:
The Vendor shall indemnify the Buyer against:
1. Claims arising from defective goods
2. IP infringement claims
3. Third-party claims due to Vendor's negligence

Indemnity shall be limited to the value of the relevant order.

sections.title: Termination
sections.content:
1. Either party may terminate with [30] days written notice.
2. The Buyer may terminate immediately if:
   a) Vendor fails to meet quality standards
   b) Delivery delays exceed [15] days
   c) Vendor becomes insolvent
3. Pending orders shall be fulfilled or cancelled as mutually agreed.

sections.title: Confidentiality
sections.content:
1. Both parties shall maintain confidentiality of business information.
2. Pricing and terms shall not be disclosed to third parties.
3. This obligation survives termination.

sections.title: General Terms
sections.content:
1. This Agreement and individual POs constitute the entire agreement.
2. Force majeure events shall excuse performance for the duration.
3. Disputes shall be resolved through arbitration in [CITY].
4. This Agreement shall be governed by Indian law.

notes: Attach detailed specifications as Schedule A
Attach price list as Schedule B
Include delivery penalty clause if needed
